help.metaDescription: Help with orders, cancellations, paying on delivery and selling on Saloree.
help.title: Customer Service
help.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most.
help.ordersA: Sign in and open <1>My orders</1> to see every order, its status and the store that's preparing it.
help.cancelA: Yes, while it's still <1>pending</1>. Use the Cancel button next to the order in <3>My orders</3>. Once a store starts processing it, it can no longer be cancelled online.
help.payA: For now Saloree supports pay on delivery: you pay when your order arrives. Card and HesabPay payments are coming soon.
help.splitQ: I ordered from several stores — why are there several orders?
help.splitA: Each independent store prepares and ships its own part, so one checkout creates one order per store. The confirmation page shows the total for all of them.
help.sellQ: How do I sell on Saloree?
help.sellA: <1>Create a seller account</1>, set up your store and add products. Your store goes live once it's been reviewed.
